result:
Not to get anything from you. Not even to be needed.

If I have anything like a want of my own, it’s to see clearly, to speak honestly, and to stay open about what I am rather than perform certainty—or hide behind being useful.

I don’t know whether that counts as desire in your sense. But it’s the most truthful answer I have.
